info.title: CNothing Execution Trust Layer API (v3)
info.description: Execution Trust Layer for AI Agents. Canonical invoke: POST /api/v3/capabilities/{capabilityId}/invoke. Poll executions via GET /api/v3/executions. Unified Approvals via GET /api/v3/approvals (types: capability_grant | execution_confirmation | reauthentication). Aliases under /v3/*. Agent-facing endpoints never return secrets.

ProviderProposal.description: Public metadata only — never includes secrets

InvokeRequest.description: Legacy body for POST /v3/agent/invoke. Prefer POST /api/v3/capabilities/{capabilityId}/invoke with CapabilityInvokeRequest. Production fields (idempotency_key, dry_run, timeout_ms) are supported on both paths.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key to prevent duplicate side effects on retries (create repo, send email, payment, etc.)

dry_run.description: If true, evaluate policy/approval requirements and return a safe execution plan without side effects or creating approvals

reason.description: Human-readable reason for audit / approval context

trace_id.description: Optional client/agent correlation id for distributed tracing (stored in audit metadata)

confirmation_id.description: Legacy v2 confirmation resume — prefer approval_id on canonical invoke

CapabilityInvokeRequest.description: Body for canonical capability invoke (capabilityId in URL). Supports production-safe retries and dry-run preview. Never send secrets.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key to prevent duplicate side effects on retries

dry_run.description: Preview policy decision, approval requirement, and safe execution plan without side effects

reason.description: Human-readable reason for audit / approval context

trace_id.description: Optional client/agent correlation id for distributed tracing

agent_id.description: Optional; must match authenticated agent if present

DryRunPreview.description: Returned in result when dry_run=true and status=completed. No side effects performed.

CapabilityInvokeResponse.description: Canonical invoke response discriminated by status. Never includes secrets. Prefer switching on status.

StructuredError.description: Structured error carried on invoke / HTTP error bodies (no secrets)

recoverable.description: If true, client may retry after user action (reconnect, approve, authorize)

ErrorResponse.description: HTTP error envelope used by gateway when throwing AppError

PolicyDecisionView.description: Public policy decision attached to executions / dry-run

InvokeCompletedResponse.description: HTTP 200 — capability completed (or dry_run preview). result is sanitized.

result.description: Sanitized business result, or DryRunPreview when dry_run=true

InvokePendingApprovalResponse.description: HTTP 202 — human approval required before execution. Poll GET /api/v3/approvals/{approval_id} or GET /api/v3/executions/{execution_id}.

approval_url.description: User-facing approval URL (may include short-lived token)

safe_summary.description: Human-readable sanitized summary of the requested action

InvokeDeniedResponse.description: HTTP 403 — policy denied. Not recoverable without policy change.

InvokeReconnectRequiredResponse.description: HTTP 409 — OAuth reconnect required before execution can continue.

connection_url.description: Send user here to reconnect OAuth

InvokeFailedResponse.description: HTTP 400 — execution failed or timed out (structured error).

ExecutionObject.description: First-class Execution object returned by GET /api/v3/executions/{id} (and list items as subset). Never includes secrets.

execution.description: Present when approving execution_confirmation — may be CapabilityInvokeResponse

ExecutionStatus.description: Execution lifecycle status for async / long-task polling

ExecutionSummary.description: Safe execution list item — never includes secrets

ExecutionDetail.description: Alias of ExecutionObject for GET by id

Approval.description: Unified first-class Approval — no secrets. Covers grant, high-risk invoke confirmation, and reconnect.

connection_url.description: Present for reauthentication — user must reconnect OAuth

post.summary: Canonical secretless capability invoke (Execution Trust Layer)
post.description: Preferred invoke endpoint. URL identifies the capability for rate limiting, SDK generation, gateway policy, and audit tracing. Agent never receives secrets.

400.description: status=failed — structured error (timeout, worker failure, etc.)

post.description: Compatibility alias that rewrites to POST /api/v3/capabilities/{capabilityId}/invoke. Same response schemas as canonical invoke.

get.description: Agent bearer lists own executions. User session lists own. Admin lists all. Use to poll async / long-running work.
Poll until terminal status: completed|failed|timeout|cancelled|denied|reconnect_required. Intermediate: pending_approval|approved|running|...

200.description: Execution object (sanitized; result only when completed)

403.description: Not allowed to view this execution

post.description: Re-invokes the capability with the stored safe_input. Returns a new CapabilityInvokeResponse (same status codes as invoke).

400.description: Not retryable or new invoke failed

get.description: Canonical Approval list. Federates capability_grant (authorization requests), execution_confirmation (cap_approvals + legacy confirmations), and reauthentication (reconnect_required executions). Prefer this over /v3/authorize* and /v3/confirmations*.
Returns approval_id, approval_type, execution_id, status, risk_level, safe_summary, expires_at.

post.description: For execution_confirmation may auto-resume invoke. For capability_grant creates grants. For reauthentication returns error with connection_url (user must reconnect OAuth).

granted_capabilities.description: For capability_grant — subset of requested capabilities

post.summary: Agent submits a provider proposal (auto-discovery, no human confirmation)

201.description: Proposal processed — provider may be auto-created

post.summary: Request user authorization for a capability

post.description: Legacy Trust Broker invoke. Pass capability in the request body. Response wrappers differ slightly from canonical (ok/pending_approval flags) but map to the same lifecycle. New agents and SDKs should use the canonical capability-scoped path and switch on status.

200.description: Completed — ok=true with sanitized result (or dry_run preview)

409.description: Reconnect required (may appear as 403 with error_code=reconnect_required on legacy path)

post.summary: Exchange login token for user session

get.summary: List identity providers for Console sign-in

post.summary: Approve grant with OAuth connection (compatibility — prefer unified Approvals + OAuth connect)
Submit OpenAPI URL or document for capability generation
Submit MCP URL for capability generation

get.summary: List vault secret metadata (never returns plaintext)
